faq.question: Q1. What is the IIPS Chief Research Officer recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by the International Institute for Population Sciences (IIPS) for 1 ad-hoc position of Chief Research Officer under the project entitled “SAHELI: Study and Action on Hysterectomy: Evidence on Women’s Health through the Life Course in India”.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Chief Research Officer position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the application form is 18 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for IIPS Chief Research Officer?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a PhD (Awarded/Submitted) in Social Sciences / Population Studies / Demography / Public Health with a focus on women’s health, along with a minimum of 3 years of experience working on women's health (middle age), at least 3 peer-reviewed publications as a first author, and experience in project coordination and stakeholder management.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is not specified in the notification.
